status: OWNER-REVIEW CANONICAL RECONCILIATION — NOT SPECIFICATION LOCKED

requirements.title: Persistent logical Project Agent identity
requirements.requirement: Each canonical project may have a persistent logical Project Agent identity that survives individual model calls, chats, processes and disposable execution-worker instances. Mutable execution workers must not become the canonical project identity.

requirements.title: Highly available Agency control plane
requirements.requirement: The Agency control plane must support one authoritative scheduling/coordination leader at a time, truthful leadership state, safe failover and recovery without duplicate dispatch or split-brain execution.

requirements.title: Fencing-token stale-commit prevention
requirements.requirement: Every lease/claim that can mutate protected shared state must use monotonic fencing/version authority so a stale worker that lost its claim cannot commit after a newer worker has taken ownership.

requirements.title: Integration and merge arbitration
requirements.requirement: Parallel Agency outputs that touch overlapping artifacts or shared state must pass through a controlled integration/arbitration path that detects conflicts, preserves evidence and never silently chooses one worker's output over another.

requirements.title: Immutable task-context packet
requirements.requirement: Each delegated Agency task must receive an immutable context packet identifying mission, project, owner rules, relevant source versions, protected assets, allowed tools, read/write scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, authorization snapshot and freshness/expiry rules. Resume must detect material context changes.

requirements.title: Agency coordination fault detection
requirements.requirement: The Agency must detect and recover or escalate deadlock, livelock, priority inversion, orphaned work, stuck/no-progress execution and other multi-worker coordination failures rather than allowing them to remain silently active.

requirements.title: Deterministic orchestration replay record
requirements.requirement: For workflows requiring reproducibility or incident analysis, Command Center must record sufficient orchestration inputs and choices—including relevant policy/plan/model/provider versions, time-sensitive decisions and controlled randomness—to explain and replay the coordination decision path.

requirements.title: Agency workload record/replay regression harness
requirements.requirement: The Agency must provide a record/replay test harness that can reproduce representative scheduler, dispatch, claim, retry, conflict, barrier and recovery workloads against deterministic fixtures without performing real protected side effects.

requirements.title: Canary and shadow Agency rollout
requirements.requirement: New worker versions, executor implementations and routing/scheduling policies must support canary or shadow evaluation before full Agency adoption, with automatic containment/rollback when evidence shows regression or unsafe behavior.

requirements.title: Dynamic logical lead registry
requirements.requirement: The Agency must maintain a dynamic registry for logical portfolio, project, department and mission leadership assignments, including authority envelope, mission, capabilities, current holder, handoff state and evidence.

requirements.title: Agency Shift Manager and incident command
requirements.requirement: The Agency must provide a Shift Manager / incident-command function that monitors queues, worker health, stalled work, resource pressure and incidents; coordinates safe handoffs and containment; and escalates only genuine owner boundaries.

requirements.title: Configurable autonomy levels
requirements.requirement: Agency missions/projects must support explicit autonomy levels OBSERVE, PROPOSE, PREPARE, EXECUTE and CONTINUOUS, or semantically equivalent levels, without any level bypassing protected-action, cost, scope or owner-governance rules.

requirements.title: Formal decision-rights registry
requirements.requirement: The Agency must use a formal decision-rights registry distinguishing decisions it may make itself, decisions covered by owner-approved defaults, decisions it may only recommend, protected decisions requiring fresh owner authorization and decisions that are prohibited.

requirements.title: Bounded owner-precedent reuse
requirements.requirement: Brain/Agency may use historical owner decisions as precedent only after comparing material context and scope. A prior decision must not be generalized to a materially different project, account, risk, cost, provider or protected action without current authority.

requirements.title: Exact conversational execution snapshot
requirements.requirement: When James authorizes execution conversationally with phrases such as 'go ahead with that', Command Center must resolve the exact referent and freeze the agreed specification/decision version before dispatch so later edits or ambiguity cannot change what was authorized.

requirements.title: Live conversational steering of active Agency work
requirements.requirement: James must be able to steer active Agency work conversationally. Material changes must trigger impact analysis, invalidate stale plans/context where required, preserve completed verified work, safely replan dependent work and never broaden authorization implicitly.

requirements.title: Durable project-specific conversational workspace
requirements.requirement: Each project must support a durable conversational workspace that retains scoped project context, owner decisions, requirements, execution snapshots, Agency status, blockers and verified results across sessions without depending on one chat remaining alive.

requirements.title: Governed Project Foundry lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Project Foundry must provide one governed lifecycle from idea intake through research, exhaustive Ultimate Spec, architecture, roadmap/DAG, owner authorization, Agency execution, verification/evidence, acceptance and post-launch lifecycle without losing lineage between stages.

requirements.title: Integrated prototype and usability lane
requirements.requirement: Foundry must support an explicit prototype/wireframe/experience-validation lane for project types where interaction or visual design should be tested before expensive implementation, while preserving the authoritative requirements and approved visual assets.

requirements.title: Foundry onboarding manifest and consolidated Needs Me setup
requirements.requirement: Foundry must generate a project onboarding manifest for required accounts, providers, credentials, permissions, devices, domains, legal/identity steps and owner actions, grouped in Needs Me by dependency/unlock impact so setup work does not emerge piecemeal late in the build.

requirements.title: Logical lead failover
requirements.requirement: Portfolio/project/department/mission leadership state must survive failure or replacement of the current model/process/worker. Failover must preserve mission, authority envelope, decisions, evidence, dependencies and exact next action.

requirements.title: Historical conversation-export ingestion adapter
requirements.requirement: Command Center must provide a safe historical-recovery import adapter for supported ChatGPT conversation-export structures, staging the import with batch identity, validation and provenance before canonical writes.

requirements.title: Complete historical message-graph import
requirements.requirement: Historical conversation recovery must process the complete available message graph rather than only conversation titles, final messages, semantic-search hits or conversations already known to be projects.

requirements.title: Branch-aware historical conversation lineage
requirements.requirement: When an imported conversation contains divergent message branches, Command Center must preserve branch/message lineage and must not flatten conflicting branches into a fabricated single chronology.

requirements.title: Historical project-container identity lineage
requirements.requirement: Historical project/template/container identifiers from conversation exports must be preserved as lineage evidence so conversations originally belonging to the same project can be associated without treating container membership alone as current canonical truth.

requirements.title: Lost-artifact locator and original-first recovery
requirements.requirement: When historical evidence references an artifact that is no longer available, Command Center must preserve the missing reference and attempt authorized original-source recovery before reconstruction. Any reconstruction must be labeled as reconstruction and may not masquerade as the original.

requirements.title: Historical recovery completeness report
requirements.requirement: Every historical recovery/import must produce a machine-readable completeness report covering source scope processed, unresolved conflicts, recovered/candidate projects, missing artifacts, rename/merge/supersession lineage, privacy exclusions, unresolved unknowns and recovery evidence.
